goal: Rebuild agent-master as a governed Agent Harness factory whose four specialized capabilities are package-private subskills inside the public parent skill.
source_material: Мастер-промпт для создания навыка специализированного агента.pdf
acceptance_criteria: the first unresolved question is public versus private structure
the parent announces and persists an execution mode before material work
the minimum-system gate precedes architecture expansion
four specialized capabilities exist only as package-private subskills of agent-master
the fixed Agent Harness factory phases preserve human and authority gates in every mode
structural, routing, behavior, state, registry, catalog, package and repository checks pass

phases.objective: Resolve repository-backed composition, visibility and orchestration practices and inspect the pinned external autopilot exemplar.
entry_conditions: the five supplied PDFs and repository are in scope
exit_checks: public parent plus package-private subskills selected
external ideas are adapted rather than copied wholesale

phases.objective: Classify the parent as an orchestrator and the four nested capabilities as private package resources with explicit contracts.
entry_conditions: source map and visibility decision exist
exit_checks: private consumers are closed to the parent

phases.objective: Materialize the four package-private subskills, their resources and their routing and behavior fixtures.
entry_conditions: the private capability contracts are approved by the parent architecture

phases.objective: Run structural, deterministic and fresh-context semantic checks on the frozen 2.0.0 candidate.
entry_conditions: candidate content is frozen for the run

phases.objective: Register only the public parent, rebuild generated projections and verify package-private containment without host activation.
exit_checks: 42 public skills and four package-private subskills validate
evidence: repository validator PASS for 42 public skills and four package-private subskills

approvals.subject: replace agent-master with a private-subskill implementation in the requested repository
approvals.scope: repository files and generated projections only

risks: package-private subskills are a repository-specific extension and require the updated repository validators and builders
fresh-context probes cover initial routing and authority behavior, not a complete production Agent Harness build
the bundled skill-creator quick validator cannot run until PyYAML is present
